Simplifies the curve AFTER the fact (fewer points, more efficient stroke) — has no effect on shakiness while drawing, that's what Stabilizer above handles. At 0: the point count isn't reduced, but the stroke can still look visibly smoothed if Stabilizer is enabled.

Smooths POSITION live while you draw (corrects hand shake) — acts BEFORE the stroke is laid down, independent of Smooth below. Off/Low/Medium/High: classic sliding average. Quill: physical spring-damper model (Google ink-stroke-modeler, like rnote), catches up to the tip on release. Set this to Off if you want a stroke that follows your hand pixel-perfectly.

Boiling line: SMLabs.boil({frames,amplitude}) places N shaky keyframe-variants of the current drawing on the following frames

Animator's roll: hold R to cycle through ±N frames around the pose, release to return to it (SMLabs.setFlipSpeed/Span)
Bake along a trajectory: SMLabs.followPath({pathId,frames,ease}) bakes the selection along a trajectory stroke into successive keyframes
Magnetic curve/ellipse guide: hold F + drag draws a stroke snapped to the guide (SMLabs.setCurveGuide('ellipse'|'line', opts))
Action: SMLabs.intervalAssistant(n, ease?) places n breakdown keyframes at eased intervals between the 2 ends of the selected range

Mirror check: hold M to flip the view horizontally (proportion check), release or click to return to normal

Speed lines: SMLabs.speedLines({cx,cy,count,r0,r1,jitter}) generates a radial burst of ordinary strokes
